intro:
You follow the setup of a subscription checkout. Finance and engineering change the payment setup more than once.

Initial specification:
- [e001] Gus confirmed in writing that the payment provider changes to `mollie`.
- [e002] Update from Ana: the login method is set to `magic-link`, effective now.
- [e003] Wren confirmed in writing that the log shipper changes to `logstash`.
- [e004] Update from Mei: the CDN vendor is set to `akamai`, effective now.
- [e005] Agreed in the sync: the primary database becomes `cockroachdb`.
- [e006] Decision: the webhook retry limit is now `3`.
- [e007] Update from Sami: the audit export flag is set to `OFF`, effective now.
- [e008] Added to the supported locales: `ja-JP`.
- [e009] Approved: `en-US` joins the supported locales.
- [e010] Approved: `es-ES` joins the supported locales.

Every event has a label of the form [eNNN] with a three-digit number. A higher number is later in time. A later event can change or cancel an earlier one.
Some material quotes old pages or copies for history. A quote of that kind is not a new statement.
